# 📋 Strike bar

- **Checklist types:** Strike
- **Area:** Bar/Cheese
- **When:** During Strike after the final bar and cheese service closes

## What you need

- Bar Lead and Build Lead
- 📦 Build Book — At the build station. Current camp-specific build and strike drawings, part counts, connection details, anchor locations, crew requirements, lift sequence, and final-state photographs for each structure.
- 📋 Clean bar
- 🍷 Bar — Bar/Cheese area (see the map). Treble Makers public wine-service bar.
- 🍷 Wine Cans — Bar/Cheese area. Cans of the Wine of the Day selected on the pairing list.
- 🍷 Wine Cooler — Bar/Cheese area. Insulated cooler used to chill wine cans; its ice is not served to guests.
- 🔧 Gray-Water IBC — Private infrastructure area. Camp IBC that contains used kitchen and shower water.
- 📦 Build Hardware Bins — Build storage area. Bins containing structure-specific fittings, fasteners, anchors, chains, and small hardware.
- 📦 Trash Bins

## Ready before normal use

- **📦 Build Book:** The page for the current asset is complete and approved by the responsible lead.
- **🍷 Bar:** The bar top is clean and dry. One lined trash bin is positioned at each side before service.
- **🍷 Wine Cans:** The Wine of the Day cans are available and undamaged.
- **🍷 Wine Cooler:** The cooler is clean, upright, and does not leak.
- **🔧 Gray-Water IBC:** The IBC has capacity for the task and has no visible leak.
- **📦 Trash Bins:** Not full.

## Steps

1. Have the Bar Lead confirm that service is closed and identify the wine to pack.
2. Pack the identified wine in its transport container.
3. Move all cooler meltwater into 🔧 Gray-Water IBC.
4. Complete 📋 Clean bar.
5. Remove the cooler, service supplies, and trash bins from the bar footprint.
6. Dismantle the bar in the reverse sequence printed in 📦 Build Book.
7. Put every bar fastener and small part in its assigned 📦 Build Hardware Bins bin.
8. Pack each clean, dry bar component in the transport group shown in 📦 Build Book.

## PASS when

- Wine and bar supplies are packed in their assigned transport containers.
- No cooler water reached the playa.
- Every bar component and hardware piece is clean, dry, accounted for, and packed.
- The former bar footprint is clear and MOOP-free.

## Finish

- Before marking PASS, return each used item to its location and leave it ready for the next person.
- Collect all MOOP.
- If an item, instruction, or solution is missing or unclear, ask the Dominatrix.

### Leave items ready

- **📦 Build Book:** The book remains complete and at the build station.
- **🍷 Bar:** No unattended belonging, crumb, trash, MOOP, sticky spot, or visible residue remains. The bar top is dry.
- **🍷 Wine Cans:** Unopened cans and any open half-can remain upright in the wine cooler. Empty cans are crushed and in aluminum-can collection.
- **🍷 Wine Cooler:** The cooler is upright and closed. Meltwater is contained and no water has reached the playa.
- **🔧 Gray-Water IBC:** All inlets and outlets are closed when not in use. No gray water is leaking or pooled around the IBC.
- **📦 Build Hardware Bins:** Hardware is sorted by asset, closed in its bin, and matches the count in 📦 Build Book.
- **📦 Trash Bins:** A trash bag is installed and is not full. No loose trash is present around the bins.

### If an item is not ready

- **📦 Build Book:** Do not build, alter, or strike the affected asset. Tell the Build Lead.
- **🍷 Bar:** Clean the bar; see task 📋 Clean bar.
- **🍷 Wine Cans:** Tell the Bar Lead before service begins.
- **🍷 Wine Cooler:** Do not use a leaking cooler. Tell the Bar Lead.
- **🔧 Gray-Water IBC:** Stop showers, dishwashing, and other gray-water-producing tasks. Tell the Dominatrix. Do not let gray water reach the playa.
- **📦 Trash Bins:** If the trash bag is full, tie the bag closed and take the bag to the dumpster. Ask the Dominatrix where to get a replacement trash bag. Install the replacement bag.

## Who to ask

Bar Lead
